title: How to walk through walls using the 4th Dimension [Miegakure: a 4D game]
summary: A short explainer showing what walking through walls would look like with movement in a fourth spatial dimension, using the 4D puzzle game Miegakure.
why: HN links it in discussions of 4D visualization and Miegakure as an intuitive demonstration of the fourth dimension.

quote.text: Miegakure is a not-yet-released 4D puzzle platformer. Think Flatland but as a 4D video game.
